subject: Offer approval request: Nora Jiang (Sr. Infra Engineer) — comp exception
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Offer approval request: Nora Jiang (Sr. Infra Engineer) — comp exception

Team —

Quick ask: we completed final onsite for Nora Jiang (hiring manager: Karthik) and she’s top of our candidates list. Nora is a senior infrastructure engineer with very deep GPU infra + low-level runtime experience; hiring manager recommends leveling at Senior (IC4) but the market for her skillset is materially above our published band.

Proposed package (initial request):
- Base: $255,000
- Equity: 0.45% 4‑yr (standard refresh cadence)
- Sign‑on: $25,000 (prorated over 12 months)
- Bonus: annual target 10%

Our comp band for Sr Infra (IC4) is $200k–$235k base. This request is +$20–55k above the band. Given urgency — candidate has one other verbal offer and can give notice in ~3 weeks — hiring manager asked for a comp exception to expedite.

Attached: resume, comp outline with justification, and debrief notes (summary of tech evaluation). Key hire rationale is the combination of production GPU infra experience, runtime memory optimizations, and proven ownership of end-to-end serving pipelines — would accelerate our runtime work by quarters.

Requesting:
1) A comp exception approval (or counterproposal) so we can move to verbal offer today.
2) Any preferred structuring (shift more to equity or sign‑on) to keep base below the band ceiling.
3) Final sign‑off path—who needs to OK before we extend?

If we get approval today I’ll draft offer docs and run the candidate through a quick verbal to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi | Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Nora_Jiang_resume.pdf; comp_outline_nora_jiang.xlsx; debrief_notes_nora_jiang.txt
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer approval request: Nora Jiang (Sr. Infra Engineer) — comp exception

Irene —

Thanks for the writeup and the fast follow. I agree Nora is a high-conviction hire and the team impact is real. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I sign off: 

- Leveling: manager recommends IC4 (Senior). Can you include two bullet points in the comp outline that explicitly map her responsibilities to our IC4 rubric (scope, mentorship, cross-team delivery)? We should avoid inflation to IC5 without evidence.
- Benchmarks: where are the comps coming from? Is the data market intel (Hacker News / recruiting market comps) or from our last 3 hires?
- Budget: is there runway in the FY to absorb the full base, or do we need to tradeoff with equity/sign-on?

Counterproposal thoughts: I’d be comfortable pushing base to $245k with a $30k sign‑on and slightly higher equity (0.55%) if that keeps us closer to band expectations for future hires. If the committee prefers to keep base under $240k, I’d ask for a larger sign‑on and an accelerated refresh window.

If Marissa/Finance can confirm budget impact and Lauren can provide final hiring committee approval, I’ll be happy to move forward.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Director, Runtime Engineering
(On Wed, Sep 30, 2026 at 09:12 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:)
> Team —
> 
> Quick ask: we completed final onsite for Nora Jiang (hiring manager: Karthik) and she’s top of our candidates list....
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer approval request: Nora Jiang (Sr. Infra Engineer) — comp exception

Irene/Karthik —

Thanks for the clear rationale. I reviewed the attached comp outline and Nora’s benchmark data. My read: market comps for this skillset are elevated; the hiring need is urgent; candidate fit is strong. Finance is prepared to support an exception up to $255k base on a one‑time approval, provided we:

- Capture this as an exception in the comp tracker with a short justification (Irene, please add to the comp request doc).
- Confirm that the majority of the incremental cost is funded from the runtime hiring bucket (we’ll mark this on the FY forecast).
- Use a $25k sign‑on rather than higher base if candidate accepts a slightly lower base during negotiation.

I approve a final offer structure up to the following conditionally:
- Base: up to $255,000
- Sign‑on: $25,000
- Equity: 0.45% (flex to 0.55% if needed for final negotiation)

This approval is contingent on one final executive sign‑off from Lauren (VP People) to ensure we capture the exception formally. If Lauren signs off, recruiting can extend a verbal offer this afternoon.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Head of Finance — Talent Spend
(Attachment: comp_outline_nora_jiang.xlsx)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer approval request: Nora Jiang (Sr. Infra Engineer) — comp exception

All —

Thanks for the context. I have reviewed the comp outline and Marissa’s conditional approval. I agree with the hiring rationale and the suggested structure. Final approval granted:

- Base: $255,000
- Sign‑on: $25,000
- Equity: 0.45% (up to 0.55% for negotiation leverage)

Irene — proceed to extend a verbal offer and secure a written acceptance. Once candidate accepts, please log the exception in the comp tracker and route the offer packet to People Ops for recordkeeping. Also confirm the start date window and any relocation considerations before sending the DocuSign template.

Approved by,
Lauren Bishop | VP, People Ops
Redwood Inference
